text:
⚠️ NAYA RULE (24 Oct): ab kahin bhi '40 baar / 40+ / 40-50 baar', '₹88 har dhalai', '1.1 lakh saal', 'Har 5 slab pe naya ply' NAHI bolna/likhna. Rough use pe sheet jaldi kharab ho sakti hai, phir customer jhagda karega.

Sirf ye line: "Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai."

Call/WhatsApp pe bhi yahi bolna. Neeche 6 chhote kaam hain (Shobhit ke phone pe WhatsApp Business + Instagram app).
1/6 WhatsApp Business → Settings → Business tools → Quick replies → 'rate' kholo → message badlo (aur purani photo hata ke neeche wali naya rate card lagao):
Rate ₹3,500 + GST per sheet (8×4 ft, 12 mm). Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai. Kitna area, kaunsa kaam (slab/column) aur kaunsa sheher? Hisaab bana ke bhejta hoon.

caption: Naya rate card (rate quick reply + catalog mein lagao)

text: Sheet ka rate nahi, har dhalai ka kharcha dekhiye. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai. Isliye har dhalai ka kharcha ply se kam padta hai. Aapka area bataiye, hisaab bana deta hoon.
3/6 Business tools → Catalog → VAJRA sheet → Description badlo:
+ GST. Halki, waterproof. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai. Slab, column, beam.
4/6 Status ke liye purani Somvaar (₹88) aur Shanivaar (40-50) wali photo mat lagana. Ye nayi wali use karo:
5/6 Instagram app → 22 Oct wali reel 'Har 5 dhalai pe nayi ply? Ab nahi' → ... → Edit → caption mein '40-50 baar chalti hai.' hata ke ye likho:
Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.

6/6 Instagram app → 21 Oct wali reel (viral, 'Har 5 slab pe naya ply? Saal ka 2.6 lakh') → Edit → teesri line 'VAJRA PP panel 40+ baar chalta hai. Saal ka kharcha sirf 1.1 lakh.' ki jagah ye likho (video waise hi rehne do):
VAJRA PP panel Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.

✅ Baaki sab maine kar diya: website, aane wali reels (40-50 wala hissa kaata), brain/AI reel engine (ab 40 jaisa number apne aap hata deta hai). Live WhatsApp ad test khatam hone ke baad (27-28 Oct) naye text ke saath badlunga.
